fields.label: ✨ AI prompt enhancer
fields.help: Needs the qwen3.5_9b…pe_i2i model (not installed). Keep OFF until you download it and pick it under Models.

fields.label: Custom output size
fields.help: Off = same size as Photo 1 (always on when there are no photos)

fields.label: Image model
fields.help: int8 = smaller/faster · fp16/bf16 = full quality, needs more VRAM

fields.label: Load as
fields.help: fp8_e4m3fn = bf16 model at half the VRAM (recommended on 12 GB)

imageSlots.emptyNote: No photos: creates a new image from the prompt. Custom output size is switched on automatically.

templates.name: Outfit swap
templates.help: Photo 1 = person, Photo 2 = clothes. Extra details optional, e.g. 'tuck the shirt in.'
templates.text: Replace the clothing of the person in <image1> with the outfit from <image2>. {prompt} Keep the face, hair, pose, body shape and background exactly the same.

templates.name: Change background
templates.help: Type the new background, e.g. 'a sunny beach at sunset'.
templates.text: Change only the background of the image to {prompt}. Keep the person or subject, their pose, lighting and the composition exactly the same.

templates.name: Change style
templates.help: Type a style, e.g. 'Studio Ghibli anime' or 'oil painting'.
templates.text: Redraw the whole image in the style of {prompt}. Keep the composition, the subject's identity and the layout the same.

templates.name: Small edit
templates.help: Type one change, e.g. 'make the shirt red'.
templates.text: {prompt}. Change only that and keep everything else in the image exactly the same.
